ORCHESTRA: continuous I-24 pilot

Real westbound recording · November 21, 2022 · 07:08 CST held-out interval. Forecasts start after five seconds of observed history and run autonomously for 20 seconds.

Preliminary 100-update, single-day regional pilot. Partial observations and outages are emulated. These results do not establish convergence, traffic-wave skill, or generalization.

Blue: saved full-model ensemble mean. Orange: recorded fixed-cohort truth. Source tracks may use offline future imagery. Empty bins have unknown coverage. Roadway coordinates are straightened metres.

Source: Gloudemans et al. (2023), I-24 MOTION: An instrument for freeway traffic science, Transportation Research Part C 155, 104311.
